reference: Independent direct lens-centered brightness integration; source-centered Gauss/trapezoid quadrature in far wings
scope: Finite sampled grids, not uniform error bounds. rho is shared per batch. Gould expansions may be outside their convergence domain at large rho/u. Gradient error is |AD-reference|*rho/A for u and rho, |AD-reference|/A for a1; exact limb-contact u/rho gradients are excluded because of the uniform-brightness logarithmic singularity.

nuts.fixed_parameters: Einstein crossing time=1, source flux=1, blend flux=0
nuts.scope: Exploratory single transit and one fixed noise realization; use diagnostics and model error alongside ESS/s. Sampling time includes sampling executable compilation; total time also includes adaptation and its compilation.

table.build_timing_scope: Concurrent with the test suite; not a performance measurement.

provenance_note: The GouldYoo docstring was clarified after measurement to state the conservative interior convergence domain. Its numerical implementation is unchanged; source_sha256 records the measured files.
